vibe_rationale: Artist-curated winter series of original WA music in community venues with silent discos and pop-up stages; small, local and credible.
fit_notes: Adult local music crowd on winter weeknights, with weak wellness adjacency and tiny scale. The City of Fremantle is the organiser and no sponsors are identified, so a modest community partnership or a warm-drink and wellness station would fit, though entry would go through the council.
